name: animal-movement-map
description: A navigable, source-linked field map of the animal movement, refreshed from public sources.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 execute animal-movement-map --local --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute animal-movement-map --local --file=db/seed.sql && wrangler dev
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute animal-movement-map --remote --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute animal-movement-map --remote --file=db/seed.sql
